notes: Ethereum mainnet, launch policy 34. Native ETH is currency0 and OG is currency1. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96: 792281625142643375935439503360000, representing 100,000,000 OG per ETH and a 10 ETH opening market cap for the standard supply. The pool LP fee is 12500 (1.25%), additional to the hook fee. Production sources, ABIs, dependencies and compiler configuration match accepted bundle 8d918c729607f1be5c14bc1b4d2e4b162b6f121f8462e77dad3af25760b1d064 from job a38b37bd-6caa-4756-9aa2-6033c44ac713. OG has no constructor arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals to its deployer. Transfers are plain; transfers to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD increment totalBurned without reducing totalSupply. OGHook takes IPoolManager, OG and the initializing factory, in that order. Its constructor deploys OGDistributor, whose constructor deploys OGAuction; discover their addresses through hook.distributor() and distributor.auction(). All four contracts deploy in the launch; no separate application deployment or post-launch setup is required. The five declared permissions encode flags 8396 (0x20cc). Callbacks require PoolManager; beforeInitialize binds the native ETH/OG pool with fee 12500 to the supplied factory. The factory deploys at a matching CREATE2 address and initializes atomically. There are no owner powers, upgrades or pause. Collection: SPEPE 0x999ce0CE8C5f7661e0c74a568FfE27CEB9177bDB. Mainnet eth_call at block 26147116 verified mintOpen() = true, totalMinted() = 1242, MAX_SUPPLY() = 5000, and totalSupply() reverts. Team: 0x90738ABe9b04622Dc0b3d015a3964Cc7D1Fd1859. Both swap directions and exact modes charge 3.5% of settled gross ETH: 2.5% rewards and 1% team, subject to integer rounding. Everyone may trade immediately. The buy fee decays linearly from 50% to 3.5% over 60 minutes; all excess enters backlog. Fees transfer during swaps when the manager has enough ETH, otherwise ERC-6909 claims immediately establish reward entitlement. Anyone may redeemFees after settlement; exits redeem unfunded reward claims automatically. Failed team sends retain fixed-destination teamCredit for permissionless retry. Only current NFT owners activate or upgrade. L1/L2/L3 weights are 1/2/4 and cumulative burn costs are 50,000/150,000/400,000 OG; upgrades pay the difference. ETH activation buys the exact OG cost through this pool with budget, price limit and deadline. Scaled accumulator, debt and credit accounting preserve pending rewards on upgrades without retroactive accrual. Level and pending follow tokenId across transfers. Zero-active fees and launch surplus enter backlog; remaining backlog streams over 30 days once active. A zero-active interval or new launch surplus restarts the remaining backlog schedule. ETH rewards are paid only on exit after 24 hours from the last activation or upgrade. Exit clears level and weight, transfers NFT custody to OGAuction and pays pending ETH atomically. Each NFT auction starts at max(10 times its previous sale price, 500,000 OG), decays exponentially over 36 hours to 50,000 OG and stays there until sold. All proceeds burn; the buyer receives level 0 and zero accrual. Website views: totalWeight, activePerLevel, pending, level, backlogLeft, streamEnd, currentAuctions (pages up to 100), price, lastSalePrice, totalBurned, launchFeeNow and decayMinutesLeft. Events cover activation, upgrade, exit, listing, sale and fee split. No website is included.
